root_cause: hyperagent-stop Hook hatte type:prompt mit command-Feld statt type:command - prompt-Hooks brauchen ein prompt-Feld (statischer String), command-Hooks ein command-Feld (Skript das stdout als Prompt liefert)

symptom: FileNotFoundError: /c/Users/barwa/... path in Python
root_cause: Git Bash which-Befehl liefert Unix-Pfad (/c/Users/...) der direkt an Python weitergegeben wurde. Python auf Windows versteht nur native Pfade.

symptom: Parry false positive: PROMPT INJECTION WARNING on official @anthropic-ai/claude-code cli.js
root_cause: TRUSTED_PATH_PREFIXES/PATTERNS fehlten Eintraege fuer offizielle npm-Pakete (node_modules/@anthropic-ai/ etc.)
fix: Whitelist in post-tool-defender.py erweitert: node_modules/@anthropic-ai/, @openai/, @google/ als TRUSTED_PATH_PREFIXES plus Regex-Patterns fuer npm/node_modules/ Pfade
prevention_rule: Bei neuen offiziellen npm-Paketen: Namespace in TRUSTED_PATH_PREFIXES eintragen

symptom: Hook errors visible at SessionStart — various hooks returning non-zero exit codes
root_cause: PowerShell hooks without explicit exit 0 return the exit code of the last command. If any internal command fails, the hook implicitly returns non-zero. Also auto-sync.ps1/sh had explicit exit 1 on git pull failure.
fix: Added exit 0 to 5 hooks (auto-sync, writeback-enforcer, reindex-codebase, notify, pending-admin-updates). Changed exit 1 to exit 0 in auto-sync (error logged to whiteboard instead). Applied to both .ps1 and .sh versions.
prevention_rule: Every PowerShell/Bash hook MUST end with explicit exit 0. SessionStart hooks must NEVER return exit 1.

symptom: TerminalVoiceOverlay .exe cannot be replaced during update — file locked by watchdog auto-restart
root_cause: Mutual watchdog: overlay and watchdog monitor each other and restart on kill (exit code != 0). taskkill /F produces exit code 1 which triggers immediate restart. Additionally, Beenden tray menu used Environment.Exit(1) instead of Exit(0), preventing clean shutdown.
fix: 1) update.ps1: Build to temp dir, then kill+rename+copy atomically in retry loop. 2) Fix App.xaml.cs: Beenden uses Exit(0) so watchdog stops cleanly.
prevention_rule: Always build to temp dir first, then swap. Never try to overwrite a running self-contained .exe directly. Use update.ps1 for future updates.

symptom: pip install fails: Fatal error in launcher: Unable to create process using python.exe
root_cause: Incomplete Python 3.13 uninstall left pip.exe in Programs/Python/Python313/Scripts without python.exe. System PATH still pointed there, shadowing the working uv-managed Python 3.14.
fix: 1) Remove dead entries (Python313, Python/Launcher) from System PATH via admin PowerShell. 2) Delete orphaned Programs/Python/Python313 directory. 3) Verify pip.exe in AppData/Local/Python/bin/ is the only one in PATH.
prevention_rule: When switching Python version managers (official installer -> uv), always verify System PATH is cleaned of old entries. path-verify.ps1 should check for orphaned Python installations.

symptom: 15 Hooks still deactivated after adding exit 0 to dot-sourced libraries
root_cause: exit 0 in a dot-sourced .ps1 file kills the CALLING hook, not just the library. hook-log.ps1 and whiteboard-insert.ps1 are loaded via dot-source by 15+ other hooks.
fix: Never add exit to dot-sourced libraries. Created 3-category classification rule (Library/Blocker/Standalone) with mandatory check before any hook edit.
prevention_rule: Before adding/removing exit to any .ps1 hook: grep for dot-source references first. If found = LIBRARY = no exit allowed.

symptom: publish.ps1 fails with UnauthorizedAccessException 'Access to ...publish/TerminalVoiceOverlay.exe is denied' even though Get-Process -Name TerminalVoiceOverlay returns nothing
root_cause: TerminalVoiceOverlay runs as a 2-process Watchdog-Pattern (Hauptinstanz + Sekundaerprozess mit --watchdog-pid=...). Get-Process -Name doesn't always find both — at least the watchdog secondary is invisible to it. The hidden process holds an open handle on publish/TerminalVoiceOverlay.exe, blocking the publish task's GenerateBundle step from overwriting it. Same pattern in ClaudeVoiceOverlay-Windows.
fix: Use Get-CimInstance Win32_Process to find ALL instances by ExecutablePath: `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -like '*TerminalVoiceOverlay*' }`. Collect all ProcessIds, kill them simultaneously with `Stop-Process -Id pid1,pid2 -Force` so neither can restart the other. Also kill the watcher.vbs wscript.exe process if running. Then `pwsh -File publish.ps1` succeeds.
related: See bug-case from 2026-04-03 for the original watchdog issue and update.ps1 prevention strategy
prevention_rule: On Windows, ALWAYS use Get-CimInstance Win32_Process for voice-overlay process discovery — never just Get-Process. The watchdog secondary instance is reliably invisible to the latter.

symptom: WPF-Button mit Press-and-Hold-Repeat-Logik (PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown startet Loop, PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp stoppt) bricht den Loop schon nach 1-2 Iterationen ab. Loslassen scheint zu frueh erkannt zu werden, obwohl der Benutzer die Maustaste weiter haelt.
root_cause: WPF-Button verliert den Hover-State bei minimaler Cursor-Bewegung waehrend gedrueckt — der MouseLeave-Event wird gefeuert (oft ungewollt) und stoppt damit den Loop. Plus: ohne Mouse-Capture werden MouseUp-Events evtl. an ein anderes Control geliefert wenn der Cursor den Button verlaesst.
fix: Beim PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown UNBEDINGT XButton.CaptureMouse() aufrufen — dann gehen alle Maus-Events garantiert an den Button bis ReleaseMouseCapture() im PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp. KEINEN MouseLeave-Handler einbauen (der ist bei WPF-Buttons unzuverlaessig). e.Handled=true setzen damit der Button nicht intern noch ein Click-Event ausloest.
prevention_rule: Bei jedem WPF-Button mit Press-and-Hold-Verhalten: Mouse.Capture() ist Pflicht. MouseLeave-Stop ist verboten.
